text: DSH More 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的插件，通过会话消息操作、工具栏和模型设置界面扩展原有 DSH。它支持编辑用户消息并从该处重新开始、删除单条消息并重建剩余上下文、永久删除会话、导出完整聊天记录为 Markdown，以及按模型设置识图和思考参数。插件还提供快速模式、独立任务和会话分组等开关功能。适合需要更细致管理对话历史和模型选项的 DSH 用户；需要在 DSH 中配置可用的模型提供方。

DSH More adds conversation and model controls to DeepSeek Harness Web. Edit or remove messages, continue from an earlier turn, delete sessions, and export chats as Markdown. Set image and reasoning options per model, use fast mode, and group sessions. It uses a model provider configured in DSH.

DSH More 的功能「编辑并重新开始」：从用户消息操作中编辑内容，并以新的子会话继续对话，保留原有会话的工作区和模型配置。选择消息操作后提交修改即可触发。
DSH More 的功能「聊天记录 Markdown 导出」：从会话工具栏的导出操作生成并下载完整记录，内容包含用户、助手和工具调用结果等条目。
DSH More 的功能「按模型配置能力」：在模型设置界面调整单个模型的图片输入、可选思考等级及兼容接口的思考参数格式；保存时写入 DSH 设置。

dsh-more README · DSH More：[English](./README.md) | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

Practical, independently switchable patches for missing context and history controls in DeepSeek Harness Web.

`dsh-more` integrates with the existing DSH interface instead of adding a separate management dashboard. Its current patch set can edit a user message and restart from that point, remove one message while preserving the surrounding context, and permanently delete a session while leaving native archive behavior intact.

dsh-more README · DSH More：> **Compatibility:** the development/test baseline is DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2`. All patches and existing peer ranges are preserved. Type, feature and isolated Host checks pass against the target RC; Windows path/build/script fixes are not a claim of Windows Desktop end-to-end verification. Node.js 24+ is recommended; the package engine also allows Node.js 22.19+.

dsh-more README · Features：| Patch | Where it appears | Behavior | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Edit and restart | User-message action row | Creates a clean continuation before the selected turn, submits the edited text, archives the source branch, and opens the child session | On |
| Delete one message | User- and assistant-message action rows | Removes the selected model-surface node, expands only when tool call/result pairing requires it, rebuilds the surviving context, and opens a child session | On |
| Permanently delete session | Separate item beside the native Archive action | Stops and unloads the target session, removes its exact JSONL persistence directory, detaches it from workspaces, and synchronizes the lists incrementally | On |
| Model capabilities | Settings → Models → Model capabilities | Configure image support, selectable thinking types and parameter formats per model | On |
| Fast mode | Composer toolbar and `/fast` | Toggle faster model service for the current session (may consume quota faster) | On |
| Markdown export | Conversation toolbar / More menu | Export messages and tool results with Windows-safe download filenames | On |
| Automatic titles |
dsh-more README · Features：Patch switches live under **Settings → Plugins → Plugin configuration → DSH More** and take effect without rebuilding the plugin.

dsh-more README · Requirements：- Node.js `>= 24`
- A working `dsh` CLI and a Web or Desktop profile on DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2`
- Access to the npm registry that publishes `dsh-more`

pnpm is needed only when installing or developing from source. For a published release, use the DSH plugin command so the package is installed into the selected DSH profile; do not install it globally with `npm install -g`.

dsh-more README · Windows: install this unreleased fix：The existing npm release is not this working-tree fix. Build a tarball with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm run check`, `pnpm run test:runtime`, then `npm pack`, or copy the resulting tarball from another machine.

For Desktop, initialize the app once, fully quit it, and use the **Desktop-supplied `dsh` command** (verify `Get-Command dsh` and `dsh --version`) to run:

dsh-more README · Windows: install this unreleased fix：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "C:\Downloads\dsh-more-0.1.1.tgz"
dsh plugin --profile desktop list dsh-more --depth 0
```

dsh-more README · Windows: install this unreleased fix：The generic npm CLI rejects the reserved Desktop profile; use the installed Desktop carrier instead of replacing its profile. For a browser Web service, use `--profile web` and restart the original `dsh web`. Web and Desktop profiles are separate. Reopen Desktop / reload the browser and check all DSH More switches. Quote paths containing spaces or non-ASCII characters. Windows Desktop manual acceptance is still required; see the [compatibility record](./docs/desktop-compatibility.md).

dsh-more README · Install the latest release from npm：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-more
```

This resolves `dsh-more` from npm and adds it to the Web profile. Restart the running Web service after the command finishes:

```sh
dsh web
```

If `dsh web` is already running, stop that process first and start it again. Then open **Settings → Plugins → Plugin configuration** and confirm that **DSH More** appears.

You can also verify the installed dependency from the command line:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web list dsh-more --depth 0
```

dsh-more README · Install a specific version：Pin the install when you need reproducible behavior or are testing a DSH compatibility combination:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-more@0.0.1
```

dsh-more README · Update to the latest release：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-more@latest
```

Restart `dsh web` after updating. Existing patch settings remain in the DSH `dsh-more` Settings namespace.

dsh-more README · Newly published releases and `minimumReleaseAge`：A Web profile may intentionally reject a release that is newer than its pnpm `minimumReleaseAge`. The safest option is to wait for that cooling period. If you published or independently verified the release and intentionally want to install it immediately, relax the policy for this command only:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add --config.minimumReleaseAge=0 dsh-more@latest
```

dsh-more README · Newly published releases and `minimumReleaseAge`：This does not change the profile's long-term configuration, but it does relax the age check for the command's dependency resolution. Do not use it for an unverified package or rebuild the profile lockfile merely to bypass the policy.

dsh-more README · Install from a local checkout：Use this path for development before publishing to npm:

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run check
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-more
```

If local linking is blocked only because another dependency already locked in the Web profile has not satisfied `minimumReleaseAge`, use the existing store and a one-command policy override:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add --offline --config.minimumReleaseAge=0 /absolute/path/to/dsh-more
```
dsh-more README · Install from a local checkout：`--offline` prevents new downloads, and both flags apply only to this command. Restart `dsh web` after installing the local checkout.

dsh-more README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-more
```

Restart `dsh web` once more. Removing the package removes its UI and runtime patches; it does not rewrite or recover session data that was already changed or permanently deleted while the plugin was installed.

dsh-more README · Edit a user message and restart：1. Hover over a user message and choose **Edit and restart from here**.
2. Change the text and select **Edit and restart**. The change is applied directly without a second preview-and-confirm step.
section: Edit a user message and restart

text: dsh-more README · Edit a user message and restart：The plugin cuts the durable log immediately before the selected message's owning turn, creates a child session with the same workspace, live preset composition, provider/model selection, and token limit, then sends the edited message as the next user input. The source session is archived, not physically deleted.
section: Edit a user message and restart

text: dsh-more README · Edit a user message and restart：The first turn in the child reuses runtime context already retained by the seed so DSH does not append a duplicate system-prompt snapshot. Normal live context assembly resumes after that turn.
section: Edit a user message and restart

text:
dsh-more README · Delete one message in place：1. Hover over a user or assistant message and choose **Delete this message**.
2. Review the message and any additional context nodes required for tool pairing.
3. Confirm the deletion.

dsh-more README · Delete one message in place：Deletion is implemented as context reconstruction, not as a tombstone placed in front of the model. The plugin selects the surviving current model surface, rebuilds ordinary balanced turns and steps in a child session, archives the source branch, and opens the child. The deleted content is absent from the child's raw history, trajectory, and future model input.

dsh-more README · Delete one message in place：Only the selected node is removed unless a tool call/result range must remain atomic. Editing is the operation that intentionally discards the selected turn and everything after it.

dsh-more README · Delete one message in place：Editing performs its state check and preallocates the continuation inside the single submission; message deletion still shows a preview before confirmation. Both operations watch DSH's incremental `session-added` event while committing. As soon as the child appears, the client hands off directly instead of refreshing the list, passing through a blank view, and then reopening. A full refresh remains only as a compatibility fallback when the incremental event is missing.
dsh-more README · Permanently delete a session：Open a session row's overflow menu and choose the separate **Permanently delete session** action. Native **Archive session** remains unchanged.

dsh-more README · Permanently delete a session：After confirmation, DSH More cancels a running task, waits for idle, flushes the session, unloads its Agent/Session handles, removes the exact persistence directory returned by DSH, and detaches the session from its workspaces. The UI follows DSH incremental events first and refreshes the lists only when those events are missing. Deleting the current session selects an adjacent visible session first so the conversation area does not pass through a blank state.
dsh-more README · Permanently delete a session：> **Irreversible:** permanent deletion does not archive the session and does not move it into a DSH More trash directory.
dsh-more README · Configure model capabilities：Open **Settings → Models**, expand a saved provider with **Edit**, and click **Model capabilities** below a model:

dsh-more README · Configure model capabilities：1. **Vision**: inherit defaults, support images, or accept text only.
2. **Thinking types**: inherit defaults, disable reasoning, or choose supported levels (off / minimal / low / medium / high / xhigh / max) and their API parameter values.
3. **Thinking parameter format**: expand the advanced option to select an installed DSH format such as OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen or OpenRouter. This applies to OpenAI Completions compatible interfaces; other protocols use native dispatch.

dsh-more README · Configure model capabilities：**Save** writes the model's `input` (`[text, image]` or `[text]`), `reasoningEfforts`, and `compat.thinkingFormat` under `llm-pi-ai.providers.<route>.models[]` in `settings.yaml`. DSH applies the changes through its live settings mechanism.

dsh-more README · Configure model capabilities：Each setting independently offers **Inherit defaults**, removing that model declaration and using DSH's catalog, provider configuration or adapter defaults. Missing declarations do not prove support: unknown models normally default to text input with no selectable thinking levels. A custom reasoning list needs at least one non-off level. The off parameter may be blank or use an explicit API value.

dsh-more README · Configure model capabilities：This replaces the old model reasoning effort patch and **never auto-fills low / medium / high**. Existing model declarations remain editable: the old patch recorded no provenance, so upgrades cannot distinguish automatically filled levels from deliberate configuration. Disabling the patch removes its controls. Native vision declarations and pi-ai settings remain effective; native DeepSeek per-model reasoning restrictions require this patch to stay enabled.

dsh-more README · Configure model capabilities：Writes carry the revision read when the dialog opens. Concurrent changes cause a conflict instead of an overwrite; reopen the dialog to retry. Save new models in the provider editor first. Native DeepSeek is also supported: image input is stored in `llm-deepseek.models[].inputModalities`; per-model thinking declarations use the model's `reasoningEfforts` extension field, applied by this patch to selectors and requests. Native thinking levels are fixed to off / low / high / max; a deployment-wide disabled policy remains authoritative.

dsh-more README · Configure model capabilities：If the dialog reports incompatible frontend and backend versions, restart DSH and refresh the page. Rebuilding or refreshing only the frontend cannot replace a Host module already loaded in memory. An incompatible response disables saving and shows an explicit diagnostic.

dsh-more README · Architecture：The diagram intentionally contains no patch names or patch count. Adding a patch should update the generated catalog and the Markdown feature table, not require a new architecture image.

The repository is divided into four responsibilities:

dsh-more README · Architecture：- **Patch manifests and implementations** — each `src/patches/<patch-id>/patch.json` is the single discovery entry for one self-contained Host/Client patch.
- **Generated registry** — `pnpm run generate` validates manifests and derives the typed catalog, default Settings schema, Host registry, and Client registry under ignored `src/generated/`.
- **Patch kernel** — `src/kernel/` owns activation, disposal, shared message-action composition, Settings projection, and patch contracts without containing DSH-specific feature logic.
- **DSH adapter** — `src/platform/dsh/` concentrates Web slots/DOM targeting, the patch API, trust checks, session access, confirmation tokens, runtime-context replay, and wire-format validation.

dsh-more README · Architecture：At runtime, the Client bundle contributes controls to native DSH slots and calls `/<plugin>/api/<patch>/<action>`. The Host bundle gates the request, dispatches it to the owning enabled patch, and lets the patch use only the DSH services injected by the plugin manifest.

dsh-more README · Why manifest-driven patches?：The generator rejects missing entries, invalid or mismatched IDs, duplicate ordering, and unsupported Client kinds. This keeps discovery, runtime activation, Settings, and build output aligned.

dsh-more README · Design principles：- **Native surfaces first.** Controls extend DSH's message rows, menus, overlays, and plugin settings instead of duplicating the product UI.
- **Clean continuations over synthetic history.** Context editing creates valid ordinary turns and steps; it does not inject deletion notices, empty assistant replacements, or special model-visible markers.
- **Preserve live composition.** Child sessions inherit the source Agent's current preset composition and model configuration rather than resolving a potentially different preset generation.
- **Centralize fragile integration.** DSH APIs, internal compatibility access, DOM selectors, request boundaries, and runtime replay live in the adapter layer rather than leaking across patches.
- **Everything switches off cleanly.** Host listeners/wrappers and Client observers/DOM contributions have explicit cleanup paths.
- **Keep native semantics separate.** Permanent deletion is a separate action; it never silently changes what DSH's Archive action means.

dsh-more README · Project layout：```text
src/
├── patches/          # Feature manifests, Host/Client code, shared wire types, tests
├── kernel/           # Patch contracts, activation, Settings card, shared UI composition
├── platform/dsh/     # Centralized DSH Host/Client adapters and security boundary

dsh-more README · Development：Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) before adding a patch. It documents the patch-directory boundary, Host/Client contracts, destructive-operation requirements, test placement, and review checklist. The current contribution guide is written in Simplified Chinese.

dsh-more README · Development：```sh
pnpm run generate       # Validate manifests and rebuild src/generated/
pnpm run peers:check    # Verify the locked peer-dependency graph
pnpm run typecheck      # Generate, then run strict TypeScript checks
pnpm test               # Generate, then run the Vitest suite

Generated source, `dist/`, and tarballs are not committed. `prepack` runs the complete check before `npm pack` or `npm publish`.

dsh-more README · Dependency updates：`package.json` declares compatible Host peer ranges, but pins the DSH development SDK to `0.2.1-rc.2` (with Cordis 4.0.5, Schemastery 3.18.5 and Zod 4.4.3). `pnpm-lock.yaml` preserves the verified graph. When changing the SDK baseline, update these pins together, reinstall, and validate:

```sh
pnpm update
pnpm run check
```

dsh-more README · Dependency updates：DSH Host peers use `^0.1.5-rc.2 || ^0.2.0-rc.2 || ^0.2.1-alpha.5`. The `^0.2.1-alpha.5` range includes `0.2.1-rc.2` on the same version tuple, without bypassing compatibility checks. Prereleases on other version tuples still require verification.

dsh-more README · Verification scope：Automated tests cover patch registry alignment, independent activation/disposal, Settings projection, mutation trust checks, confirmation expiry/tampering/staleness, message selection and clean rebuilds, runtime-context continuity, and cold/live session deletion.

dsh-more README · Verification scope：The repository does not currently contain a full browser end-to-end suite against a real DSH Web instance. After changing DSH versions or UI adapters, manually verify message control placement, patch toggles, Chinese/English native menu detection, busy-session rejection, child-session navigation, and cold/live permanent deletion.

dsh-more README · Compatibility notes：See the [desktop verification record](./docs/desktop-compatibility.md) for the actual macOS `0.1.7-rc.2` window checks. The desktop adapter navigates through `uiWorkspace.openSession()`, reads current selection from `retainedBy.mainView`, and temporarily retains newly created Sessions until their drafts can be transferred. Independent tasks, edit/delete handoffs, and current-session deletion share this adapter.

dsh-more README · Compatibility notes：Development uses the pinned `0.2.1-rc.2` SDK; Host peer ranges preserve existing RC/alpha compatibility. The removed `webRuntime` service is no longer required; requests use the authenticated Connection Fetch registry. Settings adapters support ConfigForms/SettingsForms and the previous APIs. The adapters and tests cover the current session format, message provenance, `main.conversation` slot, and JSONL persistence snapshots and location capability. For an existing local linked install, rebuild, restart DSH, and reload the page to load both the new Host and Client.

dsh-more README · Compatibility notes：- The current test baseline is DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`; future pre-release API or DOM changes can require adapter updates. Run `pnpm run test:runtime` for isolated RC Host integration checks (temporary profile and fake model; no user history or credentials).
- In-product DSH More copy is currently primarily Simplified Chinese, although native Copy/Archive selectors recognize both Chinese and English labels.
- Message actions operate only on ordinary user messages and assistant messages still present in the current model surface; editing requires a completed owning turn.
- Permanent deletion requires a `jsonl` backend with a valid location capability. Its current `locate` hook is internal; the adapter checks its presence and result. Tests cover plain and Zstandard-compressed session files.
- Unloading a live session uses tracked public Agent handles. Passive tracking spans the plugin lifetime, including periods when deletion is disabled, and preserves the caller's Cordis ownership. A live writer that predates the plugin's observation is still refused with a restart instruction, preserving write ownership and file locks.

为 DeepSeek Harness Web 补齐上下文与历史控制能力的一组实用补丁；每个补丁都可以独立启停。

`dsh-more` 不创建平行的“管理中心”，而是把能力直接嵌入 DSH 现有界面。当前补丁可以编辑用户消息并从该处重新开始、在保留前后上下文的前提下删除单条消息，以及在不改变原生归档语义的情况下永久删除会话。

> **兼容性：** 开发与测试基线为 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2`。保留全部补丁及已有 peer 兼容范围，已通过目标 RC 的类型、功能和隔离 Host 验收；Windows 路径、构建与脚本兼容修复不等同于 Windows Desktop 实机逐项验收。推荐 Node.js 24+；包引擎也允许 Node.js 22.19+。

dsh-more README · 功能概览：| 补丁 | 出现位置 | 行为 | 默认状态 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 编辑并重新开始 | 用户消息操作区 | 在所选轮次之前创建干净延续，提交编辑后的文本，归档源分支并打开子会话 | 开启 |
| 单条消息删除 | 用户和助手消息操作区 | 删除所选 model-surface 节点；只有工具调用/结果配对需要时才扩大范围；重建存活上下文并打开子会话 | 开启 |
| 永久删除会话 | 原生“归档会话”旁的独立菜单项 | 停止并卸载目标会话，移除其精确 JSONL 持久化目录，从 Workspace 脱离并增量同步列表 | 开启 |
| 模型能力配置 | 设置 → 模型 → 模型能力 | 按模型配置识图、可选思考类型及接口参数格式，不自动猜测能力 | 开启 |
| 加速 | 输入框工具栏与 `/fast` 命令 | 开关当前会话的加速。响应更快，但会更快消耗额度 | 开启 |
| Markdown 导出 | 会话工具栏 / 更多操作 | 导出消息与工具结果，下载文件名兼容 Windows | 开启 |
| 自动标题 | 新会话首次需求后 | 用当前模型生成标题，保留手动命名 | 开启 |
| 独立任务与手动归组 | 工作区下拉框 / 会话菜单 | 保留草稿创建独立任务；归组不改变工作目录 | 开启 |

pnpm install
pnpm run check
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-more
```

如果本地 link 只是因为 Web profile 中另一个已锁定依赖尚未满足 `minimumReleaseAge` 而被阻止，可以复用已有 store，并仅为这一次命令放宽策略：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add --offline --config.minimumReleaseAge=0 /absolute/path/to/dsh-more
```

`--offline` 会阻止下载新包，两个参数都只作用于本次命令。安装本地源码后同样需要重启 `dsh web`。

dsh-more README · 卸载：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-more
```

卸载后再次重启 `dsh web`。移除 npm 包会删除插件 UI 和运行时补丁，但不会重写或恢复插件安装期间已经发生的数据变更，也无法找回已经永久删除的会话。

dsh-more README · 编辑用户消息并从这里重新开始：1. 把鼠标移到用户消息上，选择 **编辑并从这里重新开始**。
2. 修改文本并点击 **修改并重新开始**，修改会直接生效，不再显示二次预览确认。

插件会在所选消息所属轮次之前切断持久日志，创建继承相同 Workspace、源 Agent 当前 Preset composition、provider/model 和 token limit 的子会话，再把编辑后的消息作为下一条用户输入。源会话只会归档，不会物理删除。

子会话第一轮复用 seed 已经保留的 runtime context，避免 DSH 重复追加 system-prompt snapshot；第一轮结束后恢复正常的实时上下文装配。
section: 编辑用户消息并从这里重新开始

text:
dsh-more README · 就地删除单条消息：1. 把鼠标移到用户或助手消息上，选择 **删除这条消息**。
2. 检查消息内容，以及为保持工具配对而必须额外影响的上下文节点。
3. 确认删除。

删除采用上下文重建，而不是向模型插入“已删除”墓碑。插件从当前 model surface 选择仍需保留的节点，在子会话中重建普通、平衡的 turn/step，归档源分支并打开子会话。被删除内容不会出现在子会话的原始 history、trajectory 或后续模型输入中。

除非工具调用与结果必须保持原子性，否则只删除用户点选的节点。会主动丢弃所选轮次及其后内容的是“编辑并重新开始”。

编辑会在单次提交内部完成状态检查并预分配延续会话；消息删除仍在确认前显示预览。两者都会在提交期间监听 DSH 的 `session-added` 增量事件；新会话一出现就直接完成交接，不再先刷新列表、短暂进入空白页再打开新会话。全量刷新只保留为增量事件缺失时的兼容兜底。

dsh-more README · 永久删除会话：打开会话行的“…”菜单，选择独立的 **永久删除会话**。原生 **归档会话** 的行为保持不变。

确认后，DSH More 会取消正在运行的任务、等待空闲、flush 会话、卸载 Agent/Session handle、删除 DSH 返回的精确持久化目录、从所属 Workspace 脱离，并优先通过 DSH 增量事件同步界面；只有事件缺失时才回退到列表刷新。删除当前会话时会先切换到相邻的可见会话，避免中间出现空白页。

> **不可恢复：** 永久删除不会归档会话，也不会把会话移入 DSH More 回收目录。

dsh-more README · 配置模型能力：打开 **设置 → 模型**，点击已保存提供方的 **编辑**，每个模型下方都有 **模型能力** 按钮：

1. **识图能力**：沿用默认 / 支持识图 / 不支持识图（仅文字）。
2. **思考类型**：沿用默认 / 不支持思考 / 自定义可选类型；自定义时可选择不思考、极简、低、中、高、极高、最高，并配置各等级发送给接口的参数值。
3. **思考参数格式**：在高级选项中选择 OpenAI、DeepSeek、Qwen、OpenRouter 等 DSH 支持的格式。该选项仅用于 OpenAI Completions 兼容接口，其他协议使用原生处理。

点击 **保存**，补丁会将识图声明写入模型的 `input`（`[text, image]` 或 `[text]`），将思考能力写入 `reasoningEfforts`，将参数格式写入 `compat.thinkingFormat`。这些字段位于 `settings.yaml` 的 `llm-pi-ai.providers.<route>.models[]`，由 DSH 的实时配置机制应用。

dsh-more README · 配置模型能力：各项均可独立选择 **沿用默认**，移除模型的对应声明，使用 DSH 的模型目录、提供方配置或适配器默认值。未声明不代表已确认支持：未知模型通常仅支持文字输入，且没有可选思考等级。自定义思考至少需要一个非「不思考」等级；「不思考」的参数值可留空，也可显式填写接口要求的值。

本补丁替代原来的「模型思考强度」补丁，**不再自动填入低 / 中 / 高等级**。此前保存的模型声明会保留并可继续编辑；由于旧补丁没有记录自动填充来源，升级时不会猜测并删除已有声明。关闭补丁会移除入口和弹窗。识图声明与自定义提供方的思考配置继续由 DSH 应用；原生 DeepSeek 的逐模型思考限制需要保持本补丁开启。

dsh-more README · 配置模型能力：保存前会检查配置版本；如果其他窗口已修改配置，本次保存会被拒绝，请重新打开弹窗后编辑。新模型需要先保存提供方配置。同时支持自定义提供方与原生 DeepSeek：原生识图声明写入 `llm-deepseek.models[].inputModalities`，逐模型思考声明写入同一模型的 `reasoningEfforts` 扩展字段，并由本补丁应用到模型选择器与实际请求。原生 DeepSeek 仅支持 off / low / high / max，参数值固定；提供方整体关闭思考时，不能用模型设置绕过。

如果出现“界面与后台版本不一致”，请重启 DSH 服务再刷新页面。仅刷新浏览器或重建前端无法替换后台已经加载的旧模块；版本不匹配时保存会被禁用并显示原因。

dsh-more README · 架构：图中刻意不出现任何补丁名称或补丁数量。新增补丁时只需更新生成目录和 Markdown 功能表，不应因为当前功能变化而重画架构图。

仓库分为四类职责：

- **补丁清单与实现**：每个 `src/patches/<patch-id>/patch.json` 是一个独立 Host/Client 补丁的唯一发现入口。
- **生成注册表**：`pnpm run generate` 校验清单，并在已忽略的 `src/generated/` 下派生类型化 catalog、默认 Settings schema、Host registry 和 Client registry。
- **补丁内核**：`src/kernel/` 负责启停、清理、共享消息操作组合、Settings 投影和补丁契约，不放具体 DSH 功能逻辑。
- **DSH 适配层**：`src/platform/dsh/` 集中处理 Web slot/DOM 定位、补丁 API、信任检查、Session 访问、确认令牌、runtime-context replay 和线协议校验。
dsh-more README · 架构：运行时，Client bundle 向 DSH 原生 slot 注入控件，并调用 `/<plugin>/api/<patch>/<action>`；Host bundle 负责请求栅栏、已启用状态检查和路由分发，具体补丁只能使用插件清单明确注入的 DSH 服务。

dsh-more README · 为什么使用清单驱动补丁？：普通功能补丁不需要修改两个根入口：

1. 创建 `src/patches/<patch-id>/`；
2. 在 `patch.json` 声明 ID、顺序、默认状态、Host 入口和 Client 类型；
3. 导出 `hostPatch`，以及 `useMessageActions` 或 `clientPatch`；
4. 在同一目录放置测试；
5. 执行生成和构建。

生成器会拒绝缺失入口、非法或不一致的 ID、重复顺序以及不支持的 Client 类型，从源头保持发现、运行时启停、Settings 与构建产物一致。
section: 为什么使用清单驱动补丁？

text:
dsh-more README · 安全模型：- 写接口只接受 `POST` 与 `application/json`，body 上限为 64 KiB，并要求 `x-dsh-more: 1`；
- 请求 authority 必须是 loopback 或显式 trusted host；拒绝 cross-site；存在 `Origin` 时必须与 Host 匹配；
- 即使旧 Client 继续发请求，Host router 也会拒绝已关闭补丁；
- 所有线协议 payload 都从不可信 `unknown` 开始，先校验再使用；
- 消息操作的状态检查会获得五分钟 HMAC 确认令牌，绑定 Session、日志 revision、surface generation、选中节点、操作类型、目标、预分配的延续会话与编辑内容摘要；编辑在一次点击内完成检查与提交，消息删除则保留用户可见的预览确认；
- 提交阶段重新读取当前状态，过期或失配的预览会被拒绝，并要求 Agent 处于 idle maintenance window；
- 续接发布失败时，会先从 Workspace 移除预分配子会话并释放其 Agent handle，再返回错误；
- 未预期的 Host 异常保留在服务端日志中，浏览器只收到通用内部错误，不暴露本机路径或堆栈细节；
- 关闭补丁时，Host setup 和 Client DOM 副作用都可以独立清理；
- 物理删除只接受绝对的逐会话 `jsonl` 定位与 DSH 固定 transcript 文件名，卸载实时会话后只删除该会话自有目录；本机路径不会返回 Client。

dsh-more README · 设计思想：- **优先延伸原生界面。** 使用 DSH 的消息行、菜单、overlay 和插件设置，不复制一套产品 UI。
- **用干净延续代替合成历史。** 上下文编辑重建合法普通 turn/step，不插入删除提示、空助手替换或模型可见的专属标记。
- **保留实时 composition。** 子会话继承源 Agent 当前 Preset composition 和模型配置，不按 ID 重新解析一个可能不同代际的 Preset。
- **集中脆弱集成。** DSH API、内部兼容访问、DOM selector、请求边界和 runtime replay 都留在 adapter，而不是扩散到每个补丁。
- **所有能力都能干净关闭。** Host listener/wrapper 与 Client observer/DOM contribution 都有明确 cleanup 路径。
- **原生语义保持独立。** 永久删除始终是独立操作，不会偷偷改写 DSH 原生“归档”的含义。

dsh-more README · 项目结构：```text
src/
├── patches/          # 功能清单、Host/Client 代码、共享线协议类型、测试
├── kernel/           # 补丁契约、启停、Settings 卡片、共享 UI 组合
├── platform/dsh/     # 集中的 DSH Host/Client 适配与安全边界

dsh-more README · 开发：新增补丁前先阅读 [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md)。其中记录了补丁目录边界、Host/Client 契约、破坏性操作要求、测试位置和审阅清单。

```sh
pnpm run generate       # 校验清单并重建 src/generated/
pnpm run peers:check    # 校验锁定依赖的 peer 契约
pnpm run typecheck      # 生成后执行严格 TypeScript 检查
pnpm test               # 生成后执行 Vitest 测试

生成源码、`dist/` 和 tarball 都不提交。`npm pack` 或 `npm publish` 之前，`prepack` 会执行完整检查。

dsh-more README · 依赖更新：`package.json` 的宿主 peer 使用兼容范围；DSH 开发 SDK 则固定为 `0.2.1-rc.2`，并同步固定 Cordis 4.0.5、Schemastery 3.18.5 与 Zod 4.4.3，避免不同版本类型混用。`pnpm-lock.yaml` 保留已验证依赖图。更换 SDK 基线时应一起更新这些固定版本，重新安装并验证：

```sh
pnpm update
pnpm run check
```

宿主 DSH peer 使用 `^0.1.5-rc.2 || ^0.2.0-rc.2 || ^0.2.1-alpha.5`。其中 `^0.2.1-alpha.5` 包含同一版本基线的 `0.2.1-rc.2`，不需要禁用版本检查；不同版本基线的预发布版仍需重新验证。

dsh-more README · 验证范围：自动化测试覆盖注册表一致性、独立启停与清理、Settings 投影、写请求信任栅栏、确认令牌过期/篡改/状态变化、消息选择与干净重建、runtime-context 连续性，以及冷/实时会话删除。

仓库目前没有针对真实 DSH Web 实例的完整浏览器端到端套件。升级 DSH 或修改 UI adapter 后，仍需手动确认消息按钮位置、补丁开关、中英文原生菜单识别、忙碌会话拒绝、子会话跳转，以及冷/实时会话永久删除。

dsh-more README · 兼容性说明：官方 macOS 桌面端 `0.1.7-rc.2` 的实际窗口验证记录见 [桌面端兼容检查](./docs/desktop-compatibility.md)。新版使用 `uiWorkspace.openSession()` 导航，以 `retainedBy.mainView` 识别当前会话；创建后通过临时 Session reference 等待草稿可用，完成交接后释放。独立任务、消息编辑/删除后的跳转和当前会话删除共用该适配。

开发 SDK 固定在 `0.2.1-rc.2`；宿主 peer 保留已有 RC/alpha 兼容范围。插件不再强依赖已移除的 `webRuntime`，请求走受认证的 Connection Fetch registry；设置层同时兼容 ConfigForms/SettingsForms 与旧接口。已适配新版会话格式、消息来源字段、`main.conversation` 插槽，以及 JSONL 后端的持久化快照和定位能力。已有本地链接安装在重新构建后，需要重启 DSH 并刷新页面以加载新的 Host 和 Client。

dsh-more README · 兼容性说明：- 当前测试基线为 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`；后续预发布 API 或 DOM 变化仍可能要求更新 adapter。`pnpm run test:runtime` 会用临时 profile 和模型替身运行隔离 RC Host 验收，不使用用户历史或密钥。
- DSH More 的产品内文案目前以简体中文为主；对 DSH 原生 Copy/Archive 元素的定位同时识别中英文标签。
- 消息操作只面向仍在当前 model surface 中的普通用户消息和助手消息；编辑要求所属轮次已经完成。
- 永久删除只支持提供有效定位能力的 `jsonl` 后端；当前后端的 `locate` 为内部接口，调用前会检查能力及返回值，测试覆盖普通和 Zstandard 压缩会话文件。
- 卸载实时会话时使用插件追踪到的公开 Agent handle。被动句柄跟踪覆盖整个插件生命周期，开关关闭期间创建的会话也可在重新开启后安全删除，且不会改变调用者的 Cordis 资源所有权。若会话在插件加载前就已持有未被观察到的写入句柄，仍会拒绝删除并提示重启 DSH，避免遗留写入锁。
dsh-more README · 许可证：[MIT](./LICENSE)
